title: Demo pickup-coordination history (v1, PROPOSED)
description: Machine-readable companion to docs/contracts/demo-history.md. Describes the shape of a story, its timeline events, a response, and a voice note — not a database schema dump; GraphQL/HTTP field names, not SQL column names.

instant.description: UTC, always. Display conversion to America/Detroit is the reading client's job.

timelineEntry.description: jobTimeline(jobId) element. Existing kinds unchanged; RESPONSE_RECORDED and JOB_DECLINED are new in v1.

detail.description: ATTEMPT_CLOSED: closed_reason text (e.g. TIMEOUT, NO_ANSWER). RESPONSE_RECORDED: response_kind (ACCEPTED|DECLINED). JOB_DECLINED: failure_reason text.

respondedAt.description: Null iff no human has responded yet, including every TIMEOUT/NO_ANSWER closure. Never set by cost calculation or any other system write.

responseKind.description: Null iff respondedAt is null; non-null iff respondedAt is non-null.

voiceNoteId.description: Present only when this response's story is one of the 'complete voice-to-resolution' stories (demo-history.md §2).

responseTime.description: Derived, not stored. attemptAt and respondedAt are the only two instants a duration is ever computed from.

label.const: time from recorded attempt to response
label.description: Fixed wording — dispatch delivery is never verified, so the label never claims to measure delivery.

sampleSize.description: Required on any aggregate read built from more than one responseTime. Not required on a single story's own reply.

turnTiming.description: Coarse, turn-level only. Word-level timing is never fabricated and never appears here.

voiceNote.description: Metadata read (GraphQL). Audio bytes are a separate HTTP fetch (demo-history.md §6) — never bundled here. PENDING until the real audio/Muse transcript/measured duration/hash are delivered; a PENDING note is never playable and carries no fabricated stand-in for any delivered field.

transcript.description: The delivered, final transcript. Null while status is PENDING.

proposedScript.description: A draft line describing what the story needs to say — never read as the delivered transcript. Null once status is READY.

durationSeconds.description: Measured, real duration. Null while status is PENDING — never an estimate presented as measured.

story.description: coordination_jobs (type=PICKUP) plus everything linked to it. No separate story table — this is a read shape, not a storage shape.

createdOn.description: America/Detroit calendar date, expressed relative to the documented anchor D = 2026-11-02 in demo-history.md §2 — never a raw offset integer at the data layer.

declinedAt.description: coordination_jobs.decided_at — present only when approve_pickup's DECLINED branch ran.
